description: The plot titled "Hidden State Mean" illustrates the average hidden state mean across different layers of a model, with three distinct lines representing different conditions. The x-axis is labeled "Layer" and is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, with tick labels at intervals of 5. The y-axis is labeled "Abs Mean" and is also a linear scale, with tick labels at intervals of 1. The blue dashed line represents the "hidden state mean before gate, avg 0.71," which shows a gradual increase from the start of the x-axis, with a notable peak at the end. The orange dotted line represents the "hidden state mean after gate, avg 0.05," which remains relatively flat and close to the baseline throughout the x-axis. The green solid line represents the "hidden state mean of baseline, avg 0.04," which also remains flat and close to the baseline, with a slight increase towards the end of the x-axis. The plot does not include any inferred data points or conclusions.
